_note: Craftax calibration: official Craftax baselines rerun on our hardware and pipeline, against the published scoreboard. Published numbers are copied from the Craftax README scoreboard (reward as % of the maximum 226; scores from outside the original paper are unverified there too).

ours._note: Our reruns of the unmodified Craftax_Baselines ppo.py and ppo_rnn.py (commit 7ce36fa0, W&B replaced by a local JSON log) on Craftax-Symbolic-v1 at 1B steps, 3 seeds batched in one process on one MI350X GPU of eg15, plus ppo.py with our Terraria-Lite settings (gamma .9998, GAE lambda .99, entropy .03, 128-step rollouts, learning rate 3e-4; several changes at once). Score: mean episode return over the last 20 updates of each seed, as a percent of the maximum 226; pct is the mean over the 3 seeds, ci the range over seeds. Source: eg15 ~/Projects/craftax/runs/calib-20261107/craftax_{ppo,ppo_rnn,ppo_ourhp}.jsonl; headline cited in DECISIONS.md C1.

smoke.note: Pipeline smoke only: upstream ppo.py with a logging-only patch, 1M steps on CPU. Not comparable to the 1B scoreboard.
